headline: Argentine Fintech Cocos Secures Kaszek Funding, Expands into Brazil
summary: Argentine investment platform Cocos closed an investment round backed by venture firm Kaszek, reaching a $500 million valuation. Funds will support its conversion into a digital bank following acquisitions of Banco Voii and Brazil's Warren.
why: Latin American wealthtech and digital banking startups are consolidating regional platforms to tap expanding cross-border retail savings.

impacts.name: Latin America Fintech
impacts.why: Kaszek's backing and the $500M valuation enable regional digital banking expansion into Brazil.
